title: WanderLust: Nixion
description: Explore Nixion's moon: A world in orbit around another world with tons of biomes. (for immersion I recomend keeping the shader on but you can take it off if you want to)
body: What originally started out as a simple modpack where I throw ideas together and do stuff but then it grew bigger. I didn't know what to do with it at first, but then I added a shader, a few tie-in mods, and half a dozen other things to really bring it all together. (Note that this isn't related to anything else with a similar name)
